shadows.name: default
shadows.purpose: Ambient separation for elevated surfaces like modals.

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Intensified depth when elements are interacted with.

components.name: Button Primary
components.description: Tactile and confident button with generous padding and distinct rounded corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7C5CFF; color: #fafafa; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 14px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-family: var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9272FF; box-shadow: 0 32px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content card with deep shadows and soft glassmorphic touches.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #161B24; border-radius: 18px; padding: 24px; color: #fafafa; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); font-family: var(--font-inter), system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { background: #1D2430; box-shadow: 0 32px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); } .ds-card-content { font-size: 16px; }

narrative.overview: Deep, ambient space with rich content making up the primary light. No distractions. The design is minimalist, utilitarian, and relies on high contrast to put the content forward. The system explicitly rejects cluttered interfaces with too many menus (traditional cable TV UIs) and avoids any elements that delay playback or distract the user.

rules.name: The Layered Space Rule
rules.body: Flat by default on the base layer, with shadows only appearing to separate elevated content or respond to hover states.

dos: Do use deep shadows to create separation for modals and hovered items against the dark background.
Do focus on the content, ensuring the UI gets out of the way of the video.
Do prioritize cinematic immersion using dark, premium aesthetics that make the content pop.
Do use generous padding and distinctly rounded corners (14-18px) for tactile elements.
donts: Don't use cluttered interfaces with too many menus (avoid traditional cable TV UIs).
Don't use overly bright or harsh colors.
Don't use slow, animation-heavy transitions that delay playback.
